channel.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
channel.description: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

item.description: NPR's A Martínez asks Chris Whipple, the Vanity Fair writer who spent time inside the Trump administration, why the president is experiencing increasing resistance to his plans.

item.title: Record cyclosporiasis outbreak and new food recalls raise concerns about food safety
item.description: Amid a record-setting outbreak of the diarrhea-causing parasite, food safety advocates say risks to food production are increasing.

item.title: Andrew Tate is seeking bail in his extradition fight. Here's why that's unlikely
item.description: There's a fear that people facing international extradition granted bail could flee. Andrew Tate and his brother face a total of 59 criminal charges in the U.K., including rape and human trafficking.

item.title: Remembering actor Tim Curry, who always committed to the bit
item.description: Tim Curry, who died on Tuesday at 80, is remembered as an actor who threw himself into things, whether as Frank-N-Furter in "The Rocky Horror Picture Show" or Pennywise the Clown in "It."
